task: Review the uncommitted changes in /work/queuekit (git diff; new files queuekit/worker.py and tests/test_worker.py). They implement milestone 2 of SPEC.md: a worker pool that pulls jobs from the SQLite queue. Look for bugs and missed spec points: visibility timeout, retry count, thread safety of the claim query, what happens when two workers claim at once. Do not edit anything. Report findings as a numbered list with file and line, most serious first.

Read-only review. In /work/gatewayd the uncommitted diff adds a token-bucket rate limiter (gatewayd/limit.py) and wires it into the request handler. Check it against section 4 of SPEC.md: per-client buckets, refill arithmetic, the 429 response with Retry-After, and behaviour under concurrent requests. List bugs, spec gaps and missing tests. No changes.

Review the diff on branch feature/session-auth against main in /work/portal (git diff main...HEAD). It adds session authentication middleware and a login endpoint. Check for: tokens compared in constant time, session expiry honoured, passwords never logged, missing tests. Don't modify files. Give me a short list of findings with severity.

Please review the staged changes in /work/billing-svc (git diff --cached). The change adds retry with backoff around the payment provider call in charges.py. I want to know: can a retry produce a duplicate charge, is the idempotency key reused correctly, are the tests meaningful. Read only; reply with findings and the lines they refer to.

Review the uncommitted milestone 4 work in /work/notesd: notesd/server.py (ThreadingHTTPServer, JSON API) and tests/test_server.py. Compare with 'Milestone 4: HTTP API' in SPEC.md. Look for wrong status codes, unvalidated input, handlers that share state across threads without a lock, and error paths without tests. Do not fix anything, just report.

Do a code review of git diff HEAD~1 in /work/catalog. The commit adds an in-memory LRU cache in front of the product lookups. Points to check: eviction order, cache invalidation on update and delete, whether the cache is safe when the app runs with several threads, stale reads. Read-only. Findings as bullets, with a one-line fix suggestion each.

Review the new file migrations/0007_split_names.py and the model change in /work/crm (see git status). It will run against the production database next week. Check the SQL for correctness, that it is reversible, that it handles NULLs, and that the tests cover the rollback. Do not run it and do not change files. Report problems only.

Review the diff for milestone 3 in /work/tasker (git diff, plus untracked tasker/cli.py and tests/test_cli.py). Spec: SPEC.md 'Milestone 3: CLI'. Check argument parsing, exit codes, output format, error messages for bad input, and missed spec points. Read only. Numbered findings, most important first; say 'no findings' if it is clean.

Review the changes to webhooks/handler.py and webhooks/verify.py in /work/shopsync (git diff). They add signature verification for incoming payment webhooks. Check: HMAC comparison, replay protection with the timestamp, what happens with a duplicate event, logging of secrets. No edits. List anything that is wrong or untested.

Review the uncommitted diff in /work/linkd implementing 'Milestone 5: hardening' from SPEC.md: request size limits, a per-IP rate limit, graceful shutdown, structured logging. For each spec bullet say implemented / partly / missing, then list bugs. Pay attention to thread safety of the rate-limit table and to the shutdown path. Do not modify anything.

Review git diff main in /work/reports. It adds CSV export of invoices with a background job. Check that customer data is filtered by tenant, that large exports stream instead of loading everything, and that failures are reported. Read-only review; reply with findings, file:line, and severity.

The fixes from the first review of milestone 2 are applied in /work/queuekit (uncommitted). Review the diff again, read-only: confirm each of these is fixed and nothing new broke: (1) claim query not atomic, (2) retry counter off by one, (3) missing test for visibility timeout. Answer per item: fixed / not fixed, with the line.

Review shorturl/store.py and tests/test_store.py in /work/shorturl, both new and uncommitted. They implement the storage milestone in SPEC.md. Look for SQL injection, collisions in code generation, expiry handled wrong at the boundary, connections shared between threads, and spec points with no test. Do not edit. Report as a list.

Review the diff in /work/agentd (git diff). It replaces the YAML config loader with a TOML one and adds environment overrides. Check precedence order against docs/config.md, error messages for bad values, that secrets from the environment are not printed, and test coverage. No changes, findings only.

Review pull request 214 in /work/ledger-api: run `git diff origin/main...pr-214`. It changes how account balances are recomputed after a reversal. Check the arithmetic, rounding, the transaction boundaries, and whether two reversals arriving together could both apply. Read-only. Give findings with severity and say what test would catch each.

Review the uncommitted changes to api/upload.py and tests/test_upload.py in /work/mediabox. Spec is in SPEC.md under 'Uploads'. Check size limit enforcement, content-type validation, path traversal in the filename, temp file cleanup on error, and authorization on the endpoint. Read only; list findings.

Read-only code review of the diff in /work/cronlet (git diff): the scheduler loop in cronlet/scheduler.py now supports overlapping jobs. Check for missed runs across DST, jobs started twice, a lock that is never released on exception, and tests that depend on wall-clock time. Report bugs and risky spots; don't fix.

Review the changes in sdk/client.py and sdk/retry.py on this branch in /work/pysdk (git diff main). Check that timeouts are applied to every request, retries only happen on idempotent methods, credentials are not included in exception messages, and the public interface matches README.md. No edits. Bullet list of findings.

Review the uncommitted milestone 1 files in /work/kvlite: kvlite/engine.py and tests/test_engine.py. Read SPEC.md 'Milestone 1'. Look for bugs and missed spec points: key validation, TTL expiry with the injectable clock, atomic write (temp file then rename), behaviour when the data file is corrupt. Do not change anything. Findings as a numbered list.

Quick review of git diff in /work/portal: it adds request logging middleware. Check that auth headers, cookies and passwords are redacted, that the log line format matches docs/logging.md, and that there is a test for redaction. Read-only. Short list of findings.

tests/test_checkout.py::test_concurrent_orders in /work/storefront fails about one run in twenty on CI and never locally. Find the cause. Read the test, the order service and the fixtures, form a hypothesis, and prove it by making the failure deterministic. Read-only for now: report the root cause and the smallest fix.

The worker process in /work/ingestd grows by about 50 MB an hour under load until it is OOM-killed. Find the leak: read ingestd/worker.py and the batching code, use tracemalloc if it helps, and fix it. Add a test that would have caught it.

Under load the service in /work/dbproxy sometimes hangs with all threads waiting; we cannot reproduce it on demand. Read pool.py and find the deadlock. Explain the lock order that causes it and fix it, with a test that forces the interleaving.

Twice last week a customer was charged twice in production. We have no reliable repro. Investigate /work/billing-svc: the charge flow, the retry wrapper and the webhook handler. Find how a duplicate charge can happen and report the root cause with evidence. Do not change code yet.

The gateway in /work/gatewayd returns a 502 for roughly 1 in 500 requests, only when keep-alive is on. Figure out why. Read the connection handling and the upstream pool, reproduce it if you can, and fix it.

Users are occasionally logged out right after a token refresh. I suspect a race condition between two tabs refreshing at once in /work/portal. Confirm or rule it out, find the actual cause, fix it and add a regression test.

The nightly export in /work/reports sometimes produces rows in a different order and the downstream diff job fails. It only happens on some nights. Find out why the order is non-deterministic and report the cause and a fix. Read-only.

After a crash during a write, /work/kvlite sometimes comes back with a truncated data file. It is rare and we have no repro. Read the write path, work out which crash point corrupts the file, fix it and add a test that simulates the crash.

Apply these review fixes in /work/queuekit, nothing else: (1) queuekit/worker.py line 88: wrap the claim SELECT and UPDATE in one transaction so two workers cannot claim the same job. (2) line 131: retry counter starts at 0, not 1. (3) add a test in tests/test_worker.py for the visibility timeout. Then run python -m unittest and report.

In /work/gatewayd/gatewayd/limit.py the 429 response is missing the Retry-After header. Add it (whole seconds until the bucket has one token, rounded up) and add one unit test. Only touch limit.py and tests/test_limit.py. Run the tests.
Review finding to fix in /work/portal: auth/tokens.py compares session tokens with ==. Replace it with hmac.compare_digest and add a unit test. Keep the change minimal and run the test suite.

In /work/catalog/catalog/cache.py the LRU cache is not thread-safe. Add a threading.Lock around get, put and invalidate, as the review asked. Add one test that calls put from several threads. Do not change the public interface.
In /work/billing-svc run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` and report: tests run, failures and errors with the test name and the key traceback line. Be brief.
Run `python -m unittest tests.test_limit -v` in /work/gatewayd and report which tests passed and failed. Do not change anything.
List every place in /work/portal where check_session() is called, with file and line. Read-only, no analysis needed.
Run the whole test suite in /work/notesd (python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .) and tell me the count and any failures. Brief.
Find where the payment provider base URL and timeout are configured in /work/billing-svc and return the file paths and the current values. Don't modify anything.
Count how many modules in /work/dbproxy import threading and list them. Read-only.
